claim: The integration decision guide lists, among a few common ways AWS customers use a combination of services, routing EventBridge or SNS events to an SQS queue as a buffer for downstream consumers.

evidence.quote: If you are using purpose-built services, a combination of services might be the best fit for your use case. The following lists out a few common ways AWS customers are using a combination of services.
Routing Amazon EventBridge or Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) events to an Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS) queue as a buffer for downstream consumers.
